name: v4_elado_poisson
_comment: ELADO (Ehebrecht et al. 2026, arXiv 2606.20771; Zenodo 20738464) Poisson file B1_test.h5 (decompressed byte for byte from the .zst). Same equation as A1: -div(a grad u) = 1, u = 0 on the boundary, P1 finite elements (scripts.tar.zst poisson_dirichlet.py: A_form = inner(a*grad(u), grad(v)) dx, L_form = f v dx with f = 1, so the operator is positive definite and source = +1). x = coefficient a, y = u, as for A1. B1 differs from A1 only in the coefficient spectrum (sigma_s0 0.02, sigma_jump 0.0267; paper Sec. 5.2). Mapping identical to v3_elado_poisson.
